The strongest evidence points to M2. Its drain is the mirror node g, and it carries zero current with Vgs = 0.263 V, well below Vth = 0.618 V. That leaves the core in its zero-current state, which explains the start-up failure. The amplifier path is dead, so g is not regulated against VDD, which also degrades line regulation. Mst2 and Mst1 are next because they show the largest line-regulation sensitivities among the startup elements. R1 and R2 don't explain the failures, since their sensitivities are negligible.

Likely a wrong gate connection (or wrong feedback node) on M2, which also leaves g unregulated and degrades line regulation."}
